description: One-call domain triage: fetches registration record (RDAP) and DNS records (A, MX, NS, TXT) in parallel, returning a single normalized record with factual signals — domain age in days, privacy-redacted flag, registrar, NS provider inferred from NS records, mail provider inferred from MX records. No synthesized scores — factual signals only. Partial results are surfaced when one leg fails (registration or DNS marked with source_error); only when both legs fail does the tool throw both_legs_failed. For the full registration record use whois_lookup_domain. For DNS types beyond A/MX/NS/TXT (e.g., CNAME, CAA, SOA) use whois_get_dns.

domain.description: Fully qualified domain name for the triage (e.g., "github.com"). Must be a valid FQDN.

name: whois_get_dossier

a_records.description: IPv4 addresses (A records). Empty when DNS leg failed or NXDOMAIN.

age_days.description: Domain age in days since creation_date. Null when created_date is unavailable.

dns_nxdomain.description: True when DNS says domain does not exist (NXDOMAIN). Null when DNS leg failed.

dns_source_error.description: Error message from the DNS leg when it failed. Omitted on success.

dnssec_signed.description: True when delegation-signed. Null when RDAP leg unavailable.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_domain`: Input is not a valid FQDN. `both_legs_failed`: Both RDAP and DoH legs failed — no data could be retrieved. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

mx_provider.description: Mail provider inferred from MX record (e.g., "Google Workspace", "Microsoft 365"). Null when no MX or DNS leg failed.

mx_records.description: Mail exchange hostnames (MX data). Empty when DNS leg failed or NXDOMAIN.

nameservers.description: Authoritative nameservers. Empty when RDAP leg failed.

ns_provider.description: DNS provider inferred from NS record (e.g., "Cloudflare", "AWS Route 53"). Null when unknown or DNS leg failed.

ns_records.description: DNS nameservers from live DNS (NS data). Empty when DNS leg failed or NXDOMAIN.

privacy_redacted.description: True when registrant contact info is privacy-redacted. Null when RDAP leg unavailable.

rdap_coverage.description: True = RDAP server found. False = no RDAP coverage. Null = RDAP leg failed (source_error set).

rdap_source_error.description: Error message from the RDAP leg when it failed. Omitted on success.

registered.description: True when the domain has a registration record. False = RDAP 404 (not registered). Null when RDAP leg failed.

status.description: EPP status codes. Empty when RDAP leg failed.

txt_records.description: TXT record values (SPF, DKIM hints, etc.). Empty when DNS leg failed or NXDOMAIN.

title: Domain Dossier
